<translate>
'''Spiritualist''' is the ki caster among the [[Special:MyLanguage/Classes|classes]]. It has the highest Energy scaling in the game and a passive that shortens the cooldowns of its damaging ki attacks, at the cost of the weakest physical stats.
</translate>

<translate>
== Passive: Ki Mastery ==

* Damaging ki attacks get '''−20%''' cooldown.
* Damaging ki attacks that also apply a '''debuff''' get '''−15%''' cooldown instead, but their debuff lasts '''+25%''' longer.

See [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Attacks|Ki Attacks]] for the techniques it applies to.
</translate>

<translate>
== Starting stats and regeneration ==

* '''Starting stats:''' PWR 10 · ENE 10
* '''Regeneration''' (per 5 seconds): health 0.5 (+0.015 per VIT) · Ki 8.0 (+0.20 per ENE) · stamina 5.0 (+0.01875 per VIT, +0.025 per RES)
</translate>

<translate>
== Stat scaling ==

The Spiritualist's standout scaling is '''Energy''' (3.7), with a good Ki Power scaling (1.9). Its Strength (0.3) and Strike Power (0.5) scalings are among the lowest of all classes. The VIT and DEF values grow on a curve as you invest more, up to 4 times the starting rate. Compare every class on the [[Special:MyLanguage/Classes#Default stat scalings|Classes]] page.
</translate>

<translate>
== Configuration ==
</translate>
{{Config|Custom Races|stats.json}}
<translate>
The class id is <code>spiritualist</code>. Its passive values are <code>cdPrimary</code> (0.20), <code>cdSecondary</code> (0.15) and <code>durationBonus</code> (0.25), set per race in <code>races/&lt;race&gt;/stats.json</code> together with the starting stats, scalings and regeneration.
</translate>
